outcome: Bacterial populations in the vagina and amniotic space
finding: The study found differences in the composition of genital microbiomes between women who experienced stillbirth and those who had preterm births, with lower Lactobacillus spp. and higher E. coli/Shigella, Staphylococcus, Gardnerella, Listeria, and Bacteroides taxa associated with stillbirths.
gest_age: Preterm birth in one group, unspecified in the other
